snippet.title: Alkahest - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A gameplay trailer showing off Alkahest's physics engine. Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
